profile.visual_desc: Large dragon with dark red scales and numerous sharp horns along its head and neck. Features glowing red eyes and a jagged, armored snout.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Intense, narrow glowing red eyes set beneath a heavy, spiked brow. Rugged crimson scales with a fierce, predatory expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Elemental fire breath emitted directly from the maw.
profile.step1_ready: Head lowered in a three-quarter front view facing down-right. Neck is extended with eyes fixed on the target.
profile.step2_windup: Head pulls back and tilts upward. Mouth opens wide to reveal sharp teeth as internal energy gathers.
profile.step3_impact: Head lunges forward, releasing a massive plume of swirling orange and yellow flames toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Fire dissipates into lingering embers. The dragon maintains an aggressive, open-mouthed pose before recoiling to a neutral stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The fire breath in Frame 4 originates from the open mouth and projects forward, following the dragon's lunging trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains structural consistency with reference. VFX timing and neck articulation align well with the source wind-up and release phases.
